sloka: तच्चाति कायं हिमवत्प्रकाशं रक्षस्ततस्तोयनिधौ पपात।ग्राहान् वरान् मीनवरान् भुजङ्गान् ममर्द भूमिं च तदा विवेश ।। ६.६७.१६१ ।।
transliteration: taccāti kāyaṁ himavatprakāśaṁ rakṣastatastoyanidhau papāta।grāhān varān mīnavarān bhujaṅgān mamarda bhūmiṁ ca tadā viveśa ।। 6.67.161 ।।

translations.english: One arm cut off, Kumbhakarna deprived of limb looked like a mountain with peak cut off. Thereafter he seized a palmyra tree and went towards Rama.
